_manual_trigger_note: Runs the identical code path as the scheduled cycle. It is a trigger, not a demo mode.
_confirmation_depth_note: Blocks behind the head before a swap is booked. 4663 produces a block every 102 ms (197 blocks in 20.2 s, measured 2026-09-19), so 100 blocks is about ten seconds. It is a choice, not a measurement: nothing in the record measures a reorg on 4663, there is no archive node to study one with, and the chain publishes no finality rule we have read. A receipt under this depth is unknown, not failed, and treasurer/reconcile.py says how far it got. PLAN section 13 states the limitation.
_cycle_deadline_resolved_by: Set at 2.4 (2026-09-19, planning/PHASE-2.md). The whole cycle's bound: a snapshot build of about 150 s, the analysts in parallel within the 630 s worker deadline, risk within another 630 s, and margin. A typical cycle is about 4 minutes; this binds only in the tail.
_retry_budget_resolved_by: Set at 2.4. One retry, and only for a reply that arrived and was refused as malformed (PLAN §9). Never for a timeout or a dropped connection: a client-side timeout is still billed (F0.9.3). The retry must fit in what remains of the worker deadline.
_max_parallel_workers_note: Set at 2.4. The runner's bounded width: how many analyst processes run at once. Four seats, four at once. Whether the gateway serves four accounts' calls at once without throttling is unmeasured.
